payload.summary: The incident involves a brute-force attack targeting the labadmin account on victim-web-01 from the IP address 198.51.100.23. There were 15 failed login attempts within a short time window, and no successful logins were recorded from this source. The account is protected and privileged, increasing the risk of compromise.

attack_chain.description: An attacker attempted to gain access to the labadmin account on victim-web-01 by performing a brute-force attack using multiple failed login attempts from the IP address 198.51.100.23.

risk_factors: Multiple failed login attempts from an unknown source
No documented change explains the activity

proposed_actions.justification: The account is being targeted by a brute-force attack, and it is a protected and privileged account. Disabling the account can prevent further unauthorized access.
